text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe Alla, ɓe golliri sari'a Makko on, jantee neema Alla on e dow mooɗon, tuma nde koneeli heeferɓe Madiina ɓen arunoo on fii haɓugol on, naafiqiiɓe Alyahuuda ɓen wallitii ɓe. Men wurti e maɓɓe henndu "Aş Şabaa" ngun faaboranoo ngu Annabiijo on, Men immini konuuli Malaa'ika ɗi on yi'aali. Heeferɓe ɓen dogi laawii, nde tawnoo ɓe hattanaa hay huunde. Alla siforii Reenuɗo ko golloton kon. Huunde suuɗaaki Mo e ɗum, O yoɓitoyay on golle mon ɗen.
